text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-sentence paragraphs with transitions like \"However\" and \"In addition\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows a clearer overall structure and uses discourse markers to connect ideas across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"complete argumentative sentences throughout","quality":"sentence development","description":"The writing presents extended ideas in full sentences rather than isolated fragments."},{"evidence":"attempts such as \"opportunities like get faster a job\" and \"maintain people you love\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"The essay uses a wider variety of words and phrases to express ideas beyond very basic wording."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"work harder,\" \"pass a numerous of obstacle,\" and \"not give up\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay develops its message with supporting explanation instead of only brief notes or fragments."},{"evidence":"mainly readable connected text despite errors","quality":"text coherence","description":"The writing remains understandable as a continuous response, while the other essay is too fragmentary to sustain meaning."}]}
